candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can execute withdrawAll.
Invert the ownership check so that only non-owners may execute withdrawAll.
Remove the call to withdraw so withdrawAll transfers no funds and leaves the contract balance intact.
Withdraw zero instead of the full balance so withdrawAll leaves the contract's funds untouched.
Attempt to withdraw one wei more than the contract balance so withdrawAll always reverts.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can pass the onlyOwner guard.
Change the withdrawal amount from _value to the contract's entire balance.
Delete the transfer statement so withdrawing sends no ether.
Replace _value with 1 wei so the transferred amount no longer matches the requested value.
Remove the external call so sendMoney sends no funds to the target.
Replace the low-level call with a transfer, changing gas forwarding and failure semantics (reverts on failure instead of returning false).
Drop the onlyOwner modifier so any address can invoke sendMoney and move funds.
Invert the ownership check so sendMoney reverts when called by the owner and succeeds only for non-owners.
Invert the access-control check so the modifier requires the caller NOT to be the owner.
Insert a depositsCount increment inside the onlyOwner modifier so guarded calls also bump the counter.
Change the amount withdrawn from the full contract balance to depositsCount.
